title: Aligning Large Language Models with Human Opinions through Persona Selection and Value–Belief–Norm Reasoning
reasoning: The paper uses the Value-Belief-Norm (VBN) theory to align LLMs with human opinions, specifically incorporating religious demographics (e.g., Protestant, Roman Catholic) and religious behaviors (frequency of religious attendance) as key persona attributes. It evaluates the model's ability to reason through these values and beliefs to predict opinions on sensitive social and moral topics such as gun control, gender views, and political ideology using the OpinionQA dataset.
